diagnosis: The fleet telemetry AI tool accepts deviceSerial in tool parameters and queries historical GPS breadcrumbs and sensor data without verifying that the authenticated user owns or manages the target device. An attacker can supply serial numbers of rival transport vehicles or private consumer trackers to harvest real-time location histories and driving routes.
